items.title: mikehasa/agentacct
items.why: This tool helps you monitor actions, token usage, and costs when experimenting with AI coding assistants.
items.summary: AgentAcct is an open-source dashboard that tracks what your AI coding tools do step-by-step, including token costs and files changed.

items.title: VictorTaelin/OptMem
items.why: It provides a quick, lightweight way for you to add memory functionality to your AI agent projects.
items.summary: OptMem is a minimal script and prompt setup that gives AI agents long-term memory capabilities.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
items.why: It offers an accessible look at how advanced AI models are expanding into physical robotics.
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini Robotics 2, an AI model designed to give physical robots whole-body movement and reasoning.

items.title: mshumer/Claude-of-Duty
items.why: It demonstrates what modern AI prompts can accomplish in web graphics development.
items.summary: Claude-of-Duty is a 3D browser game built with Three.js generated entirely from a single AI prompt.

items.title: NikolayS/PGSimCity
items.why: This interactive tool is a great visual resource for learning relational database concepts as a computer science student.
items.summary: PGSimCity is an interactive 3D city game that visually explains how PostgreSQL database internals work.

items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
items.why: Stacked pull requests are an essential software engineering workflow now supported directly on GitHub.
items.summary: GitHub introduced native support for stacked pull requests, enabling developers to split large features into smaller dependent reviews.

items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT‑5.6
items.why: Keeping track of key AI model releases helps you stay updated on modern developer tools and capabilities.
items.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, focusing on improved performance, lower latency, and reduced operational costs.

items.title: 2x, not 10x: coding with LLMs in 2026
items.why: It gives you a realistic perspective on how AI tools actually help software developers in daily work.
items.summary: This article discusses practical experiences with LLM coding assistants, arguing they provide realistic double productivity gains rather than extreme hype.

items.title: GCC steering committee announces AI policy
items.why: Understanding how major open-source projects handle AI-assisted code is important as you learn modern software development.
items.summary: The GNU Compiler Collection leadership announced an official policy governing AI-generated code contributions.

items.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
items.why: This is a significant global news event involving a missile landing inside a NATO member country.
items.summary: Polish officials reported that a missile likely originating from Russia struck a village inside Poland near the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
items.why: This major news item highlights how climate extremes are directly affecting critical European energy infrastructure.
items.summary: Record low water levels in the Danube River forced Hungary to temporarily shut down its primary nuclear power plant.

items.title: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
items.why: This is a major world news development involving a boycott by European teams in international sports.
items.summary: European football associations announced they will boycott the World Cup following a controversial FIFA financial decision.
